dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Three prominent 'O' shaped rings are visible along the upper dorsal-lateral region; they exhibit sharp contrast transitions from a dark interior core to a high-intensity white perimeter. Several 'C' shaped arcs are clustered towards the mid-section, showing irregular, jagged outer perimeters.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: There is a high spatial density of high-intensity white pixel clusters forming a reticulated network, particularly in the posterior half of the visible area. These clusters are closely packed, separated by narrow low-intensity dark channels.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest dorsal annuli form an elongated scalene triangle. A secondary geometric relationship is formed by a line of four high-intensity blobs positioned ventrally to the main annuli group, roughly parallel to the dorsal ridge line.

other_distinctive_markers: The posterior region displays a complex 'jigsaw' or mosaic pattern where high-contrast lines intersect at acute angles, distinct from the more circular annuli present in the mid-body region.
